display_long_description:
# Join discord in [Discord.gg/SharkGo]

Shark GO is an underwater adventure game centered on riding, combat and customizable equipment. 

# 🦈 Collect Sea Creatures
Collect 70+ unique sea creatures, each with their own abilities and distinct appearances.
[media]

# 🪚Custom Equipment
Collect 10+ completely free equipment items and assemble them in creative ways. Attach them at any angle to your sea creatures and build your own personalized combat mount.
[media]

# 🏊‍♀️Swimming & Riding
Enjoy full 360° underwater movement and high-speed riding for a smooth and immersive experience.
[media]

# 🐒Friends & Challenges
Team up with friends to take on powerful sea monster bosses and explore more game modes together.

[media]
